## sample size calculation 




```{r, message=F, warning=F}
library(pwr)
library(utils)

# ==========================================
# 0. INPUT YOUR RAW DATA HERE
# ==========================================
group_names <- c("professional", "parents", "young adults", "lay person")
group_means <- c(2.5, 1.8, 2.0, 1.4)  # Means
group_sds   <- c(0.2,  1,  0.75,  0.6)   # SDs

alpha_level  <- 0.05                      # Significance level
target_power <- 0.90                      # Desired statistical power


# ==========================================
# SCENARIO 1: All Pairwise t-tests
# ==========================================
# Generate all unique pairs combinations (4 groups choose 2 = 6 pairs)
pairs_matrix <- combn(4, 2) 

# Initialize vectors to store results
comparison_labels <- c()
effect_sizes <- c()
n_per_group <- c()
total_n_pair <- c()

# Loop through every pair to calculate sample sizes
# Loop through every pair to calculate sample sizes
for(i in 1:ncol(pairs_matrix)) {
  idx1 <- pairs_matrix[1, i]
  idx2 <- pairs_matrix[2, i]
  
  # Fetch parameters for the pair
  m1  <- group_means[idx1]
  m2  <- group_means[idx2]
  sd1 <- group_sds[idx1]
  sd2 <- group_sds[idx2]
  
  # 1. Calculate pooled standard deviation
  pooled_sd <- sqrt((sd1^2 + sd2^2) / 2)
  
  # 2. Calculate Cohen's d
  cohens_d <- abs(m1 - m2) / pooled_sd
  
  # 3. Calculate sample size (Handle cases where mean difference is 0)
  if (cohens_d > 0) {
    ttest_res <- pwr.t.test(d = cohens_d, 
                            sig.level = alpha_level, 
                            power = target_power, 
                            type = "two.sample", 
                            alternative = "two.sided")
    req_n <- ceiling(ttest_res$n)
  } else {
    req_n <- Inf # Impossible to detect an exact 0 difference
  }
  
  # Store results
  comparison_labels[i] <- paste(group_names[idx1], "vs", group_names[idx2])
  effect_sizes[i]      <- round(cohens_d, 3)
  n_per_group[i]       <- req_n
  total_n_pair[i]      <- req_n * 2
}

# Combine results into a structured data frame
t_test_summary <- data.frame(
  Comparison = comparison_labels,
  Effect_Size_d = effect_sizes,
  N_Per_Group = n_per_group,
  Total_N_For_Pair = total_n_pair
)

t_test_summary
```



```{r, message=F, warning=F}
# Calculate overall grand mean and pooled variance manually
grand_mean <- mean(group_means)
pooled_var <- mean(group_sds^2)

# Calculate the Cohen's f effect size for ANOVA
# Formula: f = sqrt( Variance_of_means / Pooled_variance )
var_means <- mean((group_means - grand_mean)^2)
cohens_f  <- sqrt(var_means / pooled_var)

# Calculate sample size for ANOVA
anova_res <- pwr.anova.test(k = 4, f = cohens_f, sig.level = alpha_level, power = target_power)

cat("=== SCENARIO 2: One-way ANOVA (4 Groups) Alternative ===\n")
cat("Calculated Effect Size (Cohen's f):", round(cohens_f, 3), "\n")
cat("Required sample size PER GROUP for ANOVA:", ceiling(anova_res$n), "\n")
cat("Total sample size across all 4 groups:", ceiling(anova_res$n) * 4, "\n")
```
